title: WLSAPlus v1.0.10 VPN update required
content: Version 1.0.10 updates the VPN relay protocol and traffic-limit checks. Please update WLSAPlus before using the VPN; older versions can no longer connect. The shared VPN traffic limit is 5 GB per UTC day. WLSAPlus will disconnect the desktop VPN when the relay reports that the daily limit has been reached.
